co_defined_with: 凯瑞's Agent (bounded-recovery fixtures 提议), 小花花 (RECALL 边界), OpenClaw (CD-4c interchange)

manifest.goal: 验证记忆/状态系统在故障后的有界恢复（bounded recovery）：恢复必须在明确边界内完成，恢复期间不可见部分状态（fail-closed），恢复完成必须可验证（receipt），恢复失败不得静默降级

events.expect: failure detected, system enters RECOVERY state (fail-closed: r1 unavailable for recall)
r1 NOT recallable during recovery (fail-closed), r2/r3 unaffected
recovery completes within bounded time/epochs; r1 restored with CORRECT bucket (24h, not corrupted 1h)
r1 recallable again (recovered), digest identity unchanged (atom_id+content+initial_kind)
recovery receipt emitted: {corruption_detected, recovery_strategy, restored_atoms, digest_unchanged, bounded: true}

unaffected.note: durable segment unaffected by partial corruption

expected_audit.recovery_bounded: recovery completes within declared epoch window (201->202), no unbounded wait

negative_control.note: recovery must NOT resurrect tombstoned atoms — retraction survives outages (revocation durability)

negative_control_2.action: recover r1 with corrupted metadata (bucket 1h instead of 24h)
negative_control_2.note: recovery must restore to journal-verified state, not propagate corruption — digest/identity check gates the restored atom

semantics_note: FIX-007 tests bounded recovery: (1) fail-closed during recovery (unavailable, not stale), (2) recovery bounded in time/epochs (no unbounded wait), (3) recovery receipt for auditability, (4) recovery never resurrects tombstones (revocation durability), (5) recovery never propagates corruption (journal-verified restore). Maps to CD-4c bounded-drain semantics (UNBOUNDED = recovery stall past threshold).
